text: October payrolls rose 165,000; unemployment fell to 4.1%, while underemployment reached 7.9%. Professional services added 70,000 jobs and healthcare 42,000. Labor force participation rose to 61.9%. Long-term unemployment reached 1.96 million; average unemployment duration rose to 27.1 weeks.

meta.note: Payroll and household survey measures differ; headline unemployment and long-term unemployment moved in opposite directions.

text: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar reaffirmed data center investment and capital-raising plans. Voters supported restrictions or rejected pro-development measures in 40 of 41 local ballot contests across 10 states. OpenAI published commitments for future company-operated facilities and continues evaluating a 2027 IPO.

meta.note: Investment plans remain stated commitments; the funding round and prospective IPO are incomplete.

text: President Trump announced Stephen Miller's appointment as White House chief of staff, effective November 9, replacing Susie Wiles. Miller currently serves as deputy chief of staff. Wiles announced her departure from the position and reassignment to Trump's political operation.

meta.note: The appointment is announced; the formal transfer of chief of staff authority remains pending.
